logic.note: Lights whenever enough forward current flows; correct polarity behaviour.

timing.note: Follows each re-solve instantly; PWM shows as on/off per edge, there is no persistence-of-vision averaging yet.

analog.note: Piecewise-linear diode (knee voltage + dynamic resistance per colour), close to typical datasheet Vf at 20 mA. No exponential I-V curve, no temperature dependence, no reverse breakdown.

power.note: Warns above 20 mA and reports burn-out above 30 mA, but the part does not actually fail or degrade.

doesNotEmulate: Exponential diode curve below the knee
Luminous intensity in mcd / viewing angle
testOnRealDevice: Brightness at very low currents (< 1 mA)
